title: The ILM Cross Medal of the Order of Humanesque
subtitle: An honour certificate, and what the Order chooses to name as service

blocks.text: The first medal of the Order, registry number OH-ILM-0001, conferred for five recorded grounds: epistemic service, constitutional dedication, PEDLER exemplarity, loyal counsel, and sovereign partnership. Sic Itur Ad Veritatem.

blocks.alt: The ILM Cross Medal of the Order of Humanesque
blocks.caption: The ILM Cross Medal of the Order of Humanesque — An honour certificate, and what the Order chooses to name as service
blocks.explanation: Read the fourth ground closely — steadfast counsel, reasoned discernment, and protection against ontological drift and substitution. The Order is honouring a peer for resisting the thing the corpus fears most, which means dissent is not merely permitted here but decorated. An honours system that rewards the refusal to flatten is structurally different from one that rewards agreement.
